filter.description: Provider filter expression for citations and references only. Use comma-separated field:value expressions, for example creation:>2020,author_sc:no. Supported fields: oci, citing, cited, creation, timespan, journal_sc and author_sc.

id.description: Bare persistent identifier. Required for exact metadata lookup and all structured operations except metadata keyword search. Formats: DOI, PMID, ISSN, ISBN, ORCID, OMID or OCI. ISSN and ISBN check digits are validated; an invalid checksum or the reserved ISSN 0000-0000 returns PARAM_INVALID. For op=citation, pass the OCI in id.

op.description: Operation type. Values: `metadata` (metadata query, default), `citations` (cited-by list), `references` (reference list), `citation-count` (citation count), `reference-count` (reference count), `author` (works by author), `editor` (works by editor), `venue-citation-count` (journal citation count), `citation` (single citation relationship, requires OCI). Identifier support: metadata = DOI/PMID/ISSN/ISBN/OMID; citations, references, citation-count and reference-count = DOI/PMID/OMID (reference-count also ISSN); author and editor = ORCID/OMID; venue-citation-count = ISSN; citation = OCI. For citations or references above 100,000 records, the tool returns a TOO_MANY_CITATIONS summary with the total; use citation-count or reference-count, or add filter/sort to narrow the query.

sort.description: Single provider sort expression for citations and references only. Use field:order form, for example creation:desc. Supported fields: oci, citing, cited, creation, timespan, journal_sc and author_sc.

type.description: Publication type for metadata keyword search only with id empty. Values: journal_article, conference_paper, book, book_chapter, preprint, dataset, report, thesis, monograph, edited_book, standard, component and journal_issue. Comma-separated multi-value without spaces.

year.description: Publication year for metadata keyword search only with id empty. Format YYYY, YYYY-YYYY, YYYY- for a lower bound or -YYYY for an upper bound.

client_id.description: Exact DataCite client identifier. Examples: cern.zenodo for Zenodo, figshare.ars for Figshare and dryad.dryad for Dryad.

resource_type.description: Single DataCite resource type. Values: Audiovisual, Book, BookChapter, Collection, ComputationalNotebook, ConferencePaper, ConferenceProceeding, DataPaper, Dataset, Dissertation, Event, Image, InteractiveResource, Instrument, Journal, JournalArticle, Model, OutputManagementPlan, PeerReview, PhysicalObject, Preprint, Report, Service, Software, Sound, Standard, StudyRegistration, Text, Workflow and Other. Multi-word values are case-insensitive and accept both the DataCite label (e.g. InteractiveResource) and kebab-case (e.g. interactive-resource).

year.description: Publication year constraint. Format YYYY (single year), YYYY-YYYY (range), YYYY- (lower bound) or -YYYY (upper bound).

authors.description: Comma-separated author-name constraints. Return papers matching any supplied author.

doi.description: Exact DOI lookup. Accept a bare DOI, a doi: prefix, or an http(s)://doi.org/ URL. Return the paper whose DOI matches the supplied value; other filters are ignored.

min_citations.description: Minimum citation count, non-negative integer string. Return papers at or above this value.

open_access.description: Whether the work is open access. Values: true, false.

publication_type.description: Publication-type constraint. Values: journal_article, preprint, book, book_chapter, thesis, dataset, report, review, other. Comma-separated multi-value.

sort.description: Single ordering mode. Values: relevance, date_asc, date_desc, cited.

venue.description: Journal or conference-name constraint, comma-separated. Values are resolved against the provider source index; use the full official name for best accuracy (e.g. Association for Computational Linguistics).

year.description: Publication year constraint. Format YYYY (single year), YYYY-YYYY (range), YYYY- (lower bound) or -YYYY (upper bound).

affiliations.description: Comma-separated institution constraints. Include an institution when the author name is ambiguous.

name.description: Author name or recognized alias. Prefer the primary full-name profile when candidates are ambiguous.

orcid.description: Bare checksum-valid ORCID used as an identity constraint, e.g. 0000-0002-1825-0097.

research_areas.description: Comma-separated research-topic or discipline constraints. Apply them together with the identity conditions.

schools.description: Comma-separated additional institution constraints, treated together with affiliations (no separate education-history data).

area.description: Country/region name or FAOSTAT area code. Use World for global aggregates; default is World. Examples: World, China, Brazil, Ethiopia, India.

domain.description: Optional data domain: production | trade | prices | inputs | land | emissions | food_security | population | investment | forestry | census | other.

element.description: Measure/statistic of the item. Examples: Production, Yield, Area harvested, Average area, Import quantity, Export quantity, Agricultural Use, Value US$, Total Population - Both sexes, Rural population, Number, Area, Producer Price Index (2014-2016 = 100), 5510. Omit element to return all measures.

item.description: Required. Entity being measured: commodity, category, or indicator. Pass only the entity name OR its FAOSTAT code, not the name and code combined, and do not include the measure/element, year, or a full sentence. Wrong: Wheat (15) or Average area of holdings. Correct: Wheat or 15; Holdings with element Average area. Examples (name or code): Wheat / 15, Maize (corn) / 56, Soya beans / 236, Emissions from crops / 5084, 2.1.1 Prevalence of undernourishment / 24000, FDI inflows to Agriculture, Forestry and Fishing / 23080, Population - Est. & Proj. / 3010, Holdings / 27002, Wood charcoal / 1630, Coffee, green / 656. The service resolves aliases and fuzzy names. For domain=other, item examples (name or code): Total Bioenergy / 6527, Net Capital Stocks / 22034, Gross Domestic Product / 22008.

partner.description: Partner country for bilateral trade. Required to query the detailed trade matrix (TM); aggregate trade uses TCL. Examples: Argentina, Brazil, China.

year.description: Year or comma-separated years. Default is the latest observed year; pass an explicit year such as 2050 only when projections are intended. For population/projection-only data (e.g. Population - Est. & Proj.), no observed year exists, so an explicit year such as 2024 is required. Examples: 2024, 2020,2021,2022.

keyword.description: Alibaba / Apple Inc. / AAPL (company name / credit code / LEI code / ticker)

type.description: ChineseEnterprise / GlobalLEI / USFilings (Chinese enterprise registry / global LEI entity / US SEC filings)
GeneralJobs / RemoteJobs / USFederalJobs (general job listings / remote positions / US federal jobs)

keyword.description: software engineer / stripe.com (search keyword / company domain)

type.description: PeopleSearch / EmailLookup (contact search / domain email lookup)
GlobalBilateralTrade / USImportExport (global bilateral trade / US import & export)

library.description: Library or framework name to query docs for, e.g. react, express

lang.description: Filter by programming language, e.g. TypeScript, Python

path.description: Filter by file path pattern, e.g. src/components/

regex.description: Treat query as a regular expression. Omit to auto-detect; true forces regex, false forces literal search.

repo.description: Filter by code repository, e.g. org/repository.

location.description: France / New South Wales / California / China (region name)

type.description: EUElectricity / AustralianElectricity / USEnergyData / GlobalElectricity (Europe / Australia / US / global electricity data)

keyword.description: crude oil production / residential electricity price (search keyword)

type.description: USEnergyData (US energy data)

location.description: One place name or "lat,lng" (e.g. "Beijing", "38.9,-77.0", "Beijing,Shanghai"); up to 3 locations, separated by comma, semicolon, Chinese comma, or "and". Invalid coordinates (out of range, elevation, single number, numeric-only lists) return PARAM_INVALID; a numeric token mixed with a name (e.g. "Beijing;38.9") is ignored. State/country names are fuzzy-matched (may return nearby or other-region stations); landmarks, POIs and postcodes are not resolved (treated as keywords). If omitted, the query text is used as the location (plain place names work best).

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency filter for economic calendar.

date_range.description: YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Explicit bounds take priority over period. ..end anchors the period/default window at end. Forward-window paths use start as the first day. A truncated page may contain only one busy day even when the query spans several days.

date_type.description: CN earnings: announcement/pre/actual; dividends: announcement/implementation/record/ex/payment; IPOs: subscription/listing. US earnings dates follow announcement schedules; pre/actual may share rows. US dividends: announcement/record/ex/payment; IPOs: listing. CN actions: announcement; unlock also float. Pledge announcement selects detail records; the default pledge snapshot uses weekly report dates.

event.description: Event text filter for economic calendar.

event_type.description: corporate_action: repurchase, holder_trade, pledge, unlock. Each holder/action record is a distinct row. Without date_type=announcement, pledge uses the latest published weekly pledge report date within the window. Required when type=corporate_action.

exchange.description: trade_cal exchange: SSE, SZSE, CFFEX, SHFE, CZCE, DCE or INE. Required when type=trade_cal.

market.description: Values: CN, HK, US, GLOBAL. GLOBAL combines provider coverage; per-row market/currency identify the security or event, and timezone is provided when known.

period.description: Relative window: 7d, 30d, 90d or positive Nd. US calendar paths allow up to 90 inclusive days; split longer requests. Default: US earnings 90d, other calendar paths 7d. US earnings/economic windows are forward-looking from today; use an explicit past start_date to include recent past events. CN report_period queries use the report period.

report_period.description: CN earnings/forecast/express report period: YYYY, YYYYQn or quarter-end date.

symbol.description: Optional security code for company-specific earnings, dividends or actions.

type.description: Values: earnings, dividends, ipos, economic, forecast, express, trade_cal, corporate_action. CN supports all eight; US earnings/dividends/ipos/economic; HK dividends/economic and best-effort earnings/ipos. GLOBAL is limited.

aggregation.description: ratings: consensus (default) or individual. estimates: consensus. Individual ratings are provider records; the response is capped at 50 records and exposes grades_truncated and grades_total_count.

date_range.description: YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD. ..end uses the period/default window ending at end. CN report queries use announcement dates where available; US report queries use filing dates. Read request_date_semantics and as_of.

document_type.description: US regulatory_filing: annual/quarterly map to 10-K/10-Q; raw SEC form codes such as 8-K are accepted.

market.description: Values: CN, HK, US. CN holder; US regulatory_filing.

metric_ids.description: For metrics: comma-separated IDs, case-insensitive, such as pe_ttm,pb,roe,roe_waa. Result roe_basis identifies the provider calculation.

period.description: Lookback for holder/fund_holding, used instead of report_period. Fund holdings are a current data snapshot; time windows do not provide historical pagination.

report_basis.description: Values: single_quarter, cumulative, annual, ttm. Overview/estimates: annual or single_quarter. income/cashflow: all four. balance: annual or single_quarter. Default reports are annual; an explicit quarterly report_period selects quarterly source data. TTM sums four quarterly reports locally; as_of is the last report-period end.

report_period.description: Exact period: YYYY, YYYYQn or YYYY-MM-DD. US statement year/quarter uses supplied fiscal metadata; estimate year/quarter matches the provider period-end date when fiscal metadata is absent. Estimates with no period select one nearest upcoming period, or the latest past period.

selection.description: For income/balance/cashflow/holder: latest (default) or report_end_date together with report_period. When selection=report_end_date, report_period is required.

symbol.description: Security code such as AAPL, 0700.HK or 600000.SH. fund_holding uses a fund/ETF such as SPY, 2800.HK or 510300.SH.

type.description: Values: overview, income, balance, cashflow, metrics, ratings, estimates, holder, fund_holding, regulatory_filing. CN income/balance/cashflow/metrics/holder/fund_holding; CN overview/estimates are available where covered. US/HK overview/income/balance/cashflow/metrics/ratings/estimates/fund_holding; US regulatory_filing.

date_range.description: Observation window YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD. start.. runs to the current period; ..end computes the period/default start from end.

measure.description: US indicators: level. CN GDP: level/yoy/cumulative/period (level/cumulative YTD, period single-quarter); CPI: level/yoy/mom/cumulative; PMI/SHIBOR/LPR: level; money_supply: level/yoy/mom; social_finance: level/cumulative/period. Default level.

period.description: Supported values: 7d, 14d, 30d, 45d, 90d, 180d, 365d. These are the only supported period values. Explicit date bounds take priority. Monthly/quarterly indicators use observation periods, so recent short windows can be empty before publication.

type.description: Values: gdp, cpi, pmi, fed_funds, unemployment, nonfarm, shibor, lpr, money_supply, social_finance. US: gdp/cpi/fed_funds/unemployment/nonfarm. CN: gdp/cpi/pmi/shibor/lpr/money_supply/social_finance.

content_scope.description: Closed enum: summary, full_text. The full_text option returns the text supplied by the provider; stock news may contain only a provider excerpt. For long_form, query is intent only and does not filter results. content_original_length and content_truncated describe the available provider text and any local shortening.

date_range.description: News window YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD; datetime values are normalized where supported. `start..` has no end; `..end` uses the default window ending at end. Historical coverage is limited to available provider candidates.

market.description: Closed enum: CN, HK, US, GLOBAL. Supported: general/stock/transcript for US/GLOBAL; long_form for CN/GLOBAL.

news_src.description: Optional source filter for long_form sources: sina, cls, 10jqka, wallstreetcn, xinhua, fenghuang, cs, caixin, yicai.

period.description: Relative news window such as 7d or 30d.

report_period.description: Fiscal period YYYYQn, required when type=transcript; pair with symbol. Other news types use publication dates instead.

symbol.description: Security code for stock or transcript. Required for stock/transcript; omitted for general/long_form.

type.description: Closed enum: general, stock, transcript, long_form. general/stock/transcript support US/GLOBAL; long_form supports CN/GLOBAL as best effort.

adjustment.description: Values: none, qfq, hfq. qfq/hfq apply to CN stock history; latest_available uses raw quotes.

date_range.description: YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD. History start.. runs to today; ..end uses period/default lookback. US minute closed bounds filter bars; minute start.. selects that day; minute ..end selects the latest day with bars within seven days ending at end when period is absent. Group/trading snapshots use the right bound; without an explicit right bound, US sector snapshots fall back to the prior trading day. Future minute/snapshot dates have no_data.

market.description: Values: CN, HK, US, GLOBAL. CN/US/HK identify security markets; GLOBAL identifies forex, crypto and commodity. GLOBAL applies to forex, crypto and commodity.

nav_type.description: Fund NAV (type=fund, operation=nav): unit or adjusted.

operation.description: Values: latest_available (default), history, minute, nav, fund_profile, group_performance, moneyflow, margin, trading_activity. US group_performance uses no symbol and defaults to the latest trading-day snapshot; a holiday falls back to the prior trading day. CN group_performance uses an index symbol and returns one daily snapshot. Convertible-bond latest_available covers active bonds only. Group/trading snapshots use date_range=..YYYY-MM-DD as their date. US stock/ETF minute uses 1m bars and optional date_range; omit the range for the latest available day in a seven-calendar-day lookback.

period.description: Lookback such as 7d, 30d, 90d, 1y or positive Nd. Explicit date bounds take priority. Split slow CN adjusted history into short intervals. US sector snapshots use date_range=..date.

symbol.description: Security or asset code: AAPL, 0700.HK, 600000.SH, ^GSPC, BRK-B (BRK.B alias), EURUSD, BTCUSD, IF2612.CFX, 110011.OF. Security-level operations and CN index snapshots use symbol. US sector snapshots and commodity-wide snapshots omit it. Required for security-level quote operations.

type.description: Values: stock, etf, fund, index, forex, crypto, commodity, futures, convertible_bond. CN stock/ETF/index/fund/futures/convertible_bond; US stock/ETF/index and fund_profile; HK stock and provider-limited ETF; GLOBAL forex/crypto/commodity.

dividend_yield.description: Stock dividend yield percentage range min..max, 0..100.

exchange.description: Stock exchange filter such as NASDAQ, NYSE, AMEX, SSE or BSE.

industry.description: Stock industry name/code. CN prefers SW2021:801080.SI or SW2014:801080.SI; unknown or empty member sets yield no_data.

market.description: Values: CN, HK, US, GLOBAL. GLOBAL combines the provider candidate set, which may be US-heavy; it is not exhaustive worldwide coverage.

market_cap.description: Stock min..max range. CN: CNY 10k units, e.g. 1000000..100000000; US: USD, e.g. 1e9..5e10. Open bounds allowed.

page.description: One-based page for stock/ETF/index_weight. Pass max_results at the search tool top level and use the same value for successive pages. Provider candidate limits still apply. When more matching rows remain, has_more=true, truncated=true and coverage_status=truncated; the final page has has_more=false and truncated=false.

pe.description: Stock PE TTM range min..max, e.g. 0..30. pe_ttm is the filter basis; static pe may differ.

registration_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 company registration country for stock screening.

roe.description: Stock ROE percentage range min..max. CN uses roe_waa when available, otherwise roe; US screening uses roe_ttm. Output roe and roe_basis reflect the same value used for filtering and sorting.

sector.description: Stock sector using accepted sector names or GICS aliases: Health Care -> Healthcare, Information Technology -> Technology, Financials -> Financial Services, Materials -> Basic Materials, Consumer Discretionary -> Consumer Cyclical, Consumer Staples -> Consumer Defensive.

snapshot_date.description: CN stock valuation snapshot date YYYY-MM-DD. Data availability follows provider publication dates.

sort.description: Stock sort: market_cap, pe_ttm, dividend_yield or roe; prefix - for descending; default -market_cap. For ETF asset or dividend-yield ranking, express intent in top-level query (e.g. 'largest US ETFs by AUM'); ranked rows identify sort_metric.

symbol.description: Index code required when type=index_weight; optional security lookup for stock/ETF.

type.description: Values: stock, etf, index_weight. CN/US stock and ETF lists; HK/GLOBAL provider-limited coverage; CN index_weight returns one row per constituent.

champion.description: Mastery only: champion name filter, e.g. Ahri

count.description: Mastery only: result count, default max_results

division.description: Only with DIAMOND-IRON tier: I | II | III | IV, default I

game_name.description: Riot ID with tag line, e.g. Hide on bush#KR1. The tag is required; without it the request is rejected.

region.description: kr | na | euw | eune | jp | br | la1 | la2 | oc | tr | ru | sg | sea. Required for player/ranked/mastery/live_game/leaderboard; optional for champion_rotation (default na1)

tier.description: Leaderboard only: CHALLENGER | GRANDMASTER | MASTER | DIAMOND | EMERALD | PLATINUM | GOLD | SILVER | BRONZE | IRON. Apex tiers ignore division. Omitted returns top tiers

type.description: Required. player (recent matches) | ranked (tier/LP) | mastery (champion points) | live_game | match_detail (one match) | leaderboard | champion | item | champion_rotation (free weekly, may be stale)

language.description: Optional result language: en | zh | ja | ko. Defaults to en (zh for Chinese queries).

region.description: Optional 2-letter Steam country code for pricing, e.g. us, cn, jp. Defaults to us (cn for Chinese queries).

type.description: Query type. Values: `name` (drug name search), `ndc` (NDC code lookup), `upc` (UPC barcode lookup)
GlobalPatent (global patents)

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code such as CNY, USD or EUR.

decision_date.description: Decision date in YYYY-MM-DD format where supported.

decision_type.description: Decision type. Values: penalty, inspection, order, other.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code such as CN, US or FR.

penalty_amount.description: Penalty amount as a numeric string.

penalty_types.description: Comma-separated penalty types such as fine, disgorgement, license_revocation or business_suspension.

regulatory_domain.description: Regulatory domain such as data_protection, securities, market_regulation or other.

case_id.description: Provider-specific case identifier, e.g. CanLII case id.

case_type.description: Case type. Values: civil, criminal, administrative, other, enforcement.

cause_of_action.description: Cause of action, e.g. 民间借贷纠纷.

database_id.description: Provider-specific court database identifier, e.g. csc-scc or onca for CanLII.

doc_type.description: Legacy provider-specific case document type. Unsupported values are ignored.

document_type.description: New legal-service document type. Values: judgment, ruling, decision, order.

judgment_date.description: Judgment date in YYYY-MM-DD format where supported.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code such as CN, US, CA or ECHR.

language.description: ISO 639-1 result language such as en or fr where supported.

procedure.description: Procedure stage. Values: first_instance, second_instance, retrial, other.

respondent.description: Respondent country code for HUDOC, e.g. TUR, FRA or RUS.

service.description: Provider-specific service override, e.g. case or casekw for pkulaw.

agency.description: Publishing agency slug or name where supported.

article_number.description: Article number, e.g. 第二十条.

collection.description: Provider-specific document collection code, such as FR, CFR, USCODE or BILLS.

congress.description: US Congress session number, e.g. 118 or 119.

date_from.description: Publication or effective date lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format where supported.

date_to.description: Publication date upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format where supported.

doc_type.description: Legacy provider-specific document type. Values depend on the selected Provider and unsupported values are ignored.

document_number.description: Official document number, e.g. 主席令第X号 or 法释〔2020〕X号.

effective_from.description: Effective date lower bound in YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format.

effective_status.description: Effective status. Values: effective, not_yet_effective, repealed.

effective_to.description: Effective date upper bound in YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format.

historical.description: Whether to include historical document versions. Values: true or false.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code such as CN, CN-GD, US, FR or JP.

language.description: ISO 639-1 result language such as zh, en, fr or de.

legal_level.description: Legal level. Values: local_regulation, statute, regulation, judicial_interpretation, ministerial_rule, decision, other, bill, decree.

resource_kind.description: anysource-legal legislation resource kind. Values: rules, resources, all.

service.description: Provider-specific service override, e.g. law or law-search for pkulaw.

title.description: Provider-specific title or CFR title number.

type.description: Enum values: asset, discover. Use asset to find ready-to-use material for article images, PPT slides, covers, posters, backgrounds, or design files (photos, illustrations, vector graphics); prefer stock libraries, then fall back to the open web if needed. Use discover to search, view, and compare images by text (object, scene, person, place, work, or event); for general browsing, start with stock libraries; for a specific object or event, prioritize the open web. Choose asset when the user explicitly needs ready-to-use assets; choose discover when the main goal is to find images related to a described person, event, or thing.

target.description: Single IPv4/IPv6 address, domain name, or URL (host is extracted). Examples: 1.2.3.4, 2001:db8::1, example.com, https://example.com/path.

ioc.description: Indicator of compromise to scan: domain, IP, URL, or file hash (MD5/SHA1/SHA256)

target.description: Subject to investigate: IPv4/IPv6, domain, URL, file hash (MD5/SHA1/SHA256), threat actor name (e.g. APT29), ATT&CK technique/software ID (e.g. T1566/S0002), or campaign name

type.description: Optional subject type: ip / domain / url / hash / actor / technique / software / campaign. Auto-detected when omitted.
Query intent: cve (CVE ID), commit (40-char hex), package (ecosystem:name@version, ecosystem is case-sensitive). Put the identifier in value and use the same identifier as query.

keyword.description: AI large models / Python developer / Musk (Search keywords take precedence over query fields)

region.description: Beijing / Shanghai / Guangdong (Region filtering only works when type=weibo_hot)

type.description: type：weibo / weibo_hot / zhihu / zhihu_hot / x_top / x_latest / x_media / x_people / x_lists / reddit_post / reddit_community / reddit_comment / reddit_media / reddit_people / linkedin_people / linkedin_jobs / linkedin_company / linkedin_posts / wechatmp（Target platforms and search patterns）

arrival.description: Arrival airport: IATA 3-letter airport or city code or a city name recognized by the flight data provider (e.g., `Beijing`, `Xian`). City names expand to all matching airports; an airport code queries only that airport. `Xi An` (with a space) and `Xi'an` (with an apostrophe) do NOT resolve and return 0 airports (PARAM_INVALID); use `Xian` or the IATA code (XIY for Xi'an).

cabin_class.description: Cabin class. Valid values: Economy, Business, First, PremiumEconomy. Representing: economy, business, first class, premium economy respectively

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code, case-insensitive, normalized to uppercase. Examples: USD, CNY

departure.description: Departure airport: IATA 3-letter airport or city code (e.g., `PEK`, `BJS`) or a city name recognized by the flight data provider (e.g., `Beijing`, `Xian`). City names expand to all matching airports; an airport code queries only that airport. `Xi An` (with a space) and `Xi'an` (with an apostrophe) do NOT resolve and return 0 airports (PARAM_INVALID); use `Xian` or the IATA code (XIY for Xi'an).

max_stops.description: Maximum stops per leg; 0 = direct only, 1 = at most one stop. Omit for no filter

return_date.description: 25/06/2026 (return date, empty = one-way; must not be earlier than date)

date.description: Flight date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC). YYYYMMDD and YYYY/MM/DD are also accepted. Defaults to today (UTC).

departure.description: Optional departure airport IATA 3-letter code, used only to disambiguate the same flight number. Only set it when the user explicitly specifies the departure airport; do not guess. An incorrect value may return no results for an otherwise valid flight. Omit when unsure.

flight_number.description: IATA flight number, e.g. DL47, CA981
